856-5231-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3967-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3967-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5670-7286.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-7286.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-7286.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, South Wind Avatar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2178-2380-8095.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-8095.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

687-2034-4613-8130-8133.description:
Cast Goblin-town Flunkies by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Goblin-town Flunkies enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Goblin-town Flunkies and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Goblin-town Flunkies from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-4613-8130-8133.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

101-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
101-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
101-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Vampire Charmseeker and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

710-3899-5617.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

301-5643-8095.easyPrerequisites: You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-5643-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

640-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3375-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

413-1580-4871-4976.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Open the Graves and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

129-969-1409-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2741-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
2741-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

2981-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2981-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1115-1563-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1456-3459-5078-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3967-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1580-4050-5631.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1690-2364-2538-4985.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
1690-2364-2538-4985.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast a historic permanent by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-4985.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2131-2541-3674.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Necroplasm.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2292-3174-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
2292-3174-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-2744-3192.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2440-2744-3192.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Saproling you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant

678-891-2034-2719-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
678-891-2034-2719-5214.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, adding {C}{C}.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, Enduring Renewal and Next of Kin trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Next of Kin trigger, putting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

342-1284-1729-2719-4385.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Shelob.
Shelob does not have summoning sickness.
342-1284-1729-2719-4385.description:
Activate Shelob by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Sliver Queen.
Sliver Queen dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch, triggering Shelob, creating a token copy of Sliver Queen that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Sliver Queen token by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat step 3.

2837-3259-3279.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Hoarding Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
2837-3259-3279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hoarding Ogre as attackers.
Hoarding Ogre triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and create at least one 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite Cat tokens, you may instead make Dog tokens using Jinnie Fay or Treasure tokens.

643-1413-2534.notablePrerequisites: Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
643-1413-2534.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Repeat.

4740-5159.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 51.
You have a way to give lifelink to a creature.
4740-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Aetherflux Reservoir that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature named Mishra's Warform with haste.
Give Mishra's Warform lifelink.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

632-1978-3621-4050.notablePrerequisites: Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-1978-3621-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scarecrone.
Repeat.

1032-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Power of Fire attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1032-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Power of Fire ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
